page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression rated in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core capabilities are more robust, achieving average tier performance in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given its dedicated 32-core architecture and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for parallelized workloads that do not require high memory-per-core ratios. It is suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It is less suitable for single-threaded applications or memory-intensive databases due to its lower single-core performance and restricted memory capacity per core.
